record.name: Snežana Marković
record.title: Professor Emeritus
record.bio: Snežana Marković completed her medical degree at the University of Novi Sad Faculty of Medicine in 1978 and her doctoral dissertation in diagnostic radiology at the University of Belgrade in 1989. She spent her entire academic career at the Faculty of Medicine in Novi Sad, reaching the rank of Full Professor in 2001 and retiring as Professor Emeritus in 2017. Her research focused on measuring and reducing occupational radiation doses in interventional fluoroscopy suites, including the development of department-level dose optimisation protocols for cardiologists, radiologists, and nursing staff. She supervised the Radiation Protection Laboratory at the Clinical Centre of Vojvodina, where the group used ionisation chambers, thermoluminescent dosimeters, and real-time electronic personal dosimeters. She taught radiation protection to medical students and residents for over three decades.
record.industry_experience: Professor Marković provided expert consultation to two regional hospital procurement committees during fluoroscopy equipment tender processes in 2008 and 2014, advising on dose management capabilities and shielding specifications.
record.notes: Retired since 2017; available for consulting engagements on a limited basis, particularly in the areas of dose optimisation protocol development, radiation protection audits for interventional suites, and review of occupational monitoring programmes. Not available for project coordination or laboratory work. Prefers written communication in the first instance.
